description: List available SWMM-2D model projects under the project-root models directory, then check each discovered model project for model.yaml, baseline SWMM scenario, CA2D static model, mapping, events, and runs structure.

For the selected model project's baseline SWMM input under models/<model_name>/swmm/scenarios/baseline/model.inp, create a rainfall stress scenario by multiplying rainfall time series values by 1.5, save the modified model under outputs/rainfall_150.inp, then run or prepare code to compare baseline and scenario runoff or link flow.

For the selected model project's baseline SWMM input under models/<model_name>/swmm/scenarios/baseline/model.inp, add a SWMM control rule that opens a regulator link when a selected upstream node depth exceeds a threshold. Ask for IDs if they are not known.

Create a demo CA2D static model under outputs/ca2d_model_demo, then run the SWMM-2D surface flooding model using a project-root node flooding TSV file, save outputs under outputs/swmm_2d_demo_outputs, and summarize the maximum depth and generated files.
Check whether the CA2D static model under the selected model project's static/ directory is complete. If it is missing, explain which files are required for SWMM-2D coupling.
